title: Co-Modifying Application Code and Deployment Infrastructure: A Causal Study of AI Agent Pull Requests
abstract: arXiv:2610.12849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current software engineering agents are evaluated predominantly inside isolated sandboxes against synchronous local tests. However, deploying features in collaborative repositories requires modifying continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines, containers, and provisioning manifests alongside application logic. Because agents lack deployment awareness, attempting cross-domain modifications introduces unverified dependencies into asynchronous integration pipelines. To isolate the causal integration overhead of dual-scope pull requests (PRs)-modifying both application code and deployment infrastructure-we evaluated 26,999 PRs across two large datasets (AIDev v5 and MOSAIC-3M) encompassing six agent architectures and an aligned human baseline. Using a deterministic four-tier file taxonomy and an exact 4D strata-matching framework, we isolated integration metrics under conditional exchangeability while controlling for application volume. translated_title: 同时修改应用代码与部署基础设施：AI智能体拉取请求的因果研究
translated_abstract: 当前的软件工程智能体主要在隔离的沙盒环境中、针对本地同步测试进行评估。然而，在协作式代码仓库中部署新功能，除了修改应用逻辑之外，还需要同步修改持续集成/持续交付（CI/CD）流水线、容器以及资源供给清单。由于智能体缺乏部署感知能力，尝试这类跨领域修改会向异步集成流水线中引入未经验证的依赖。为了分离“双范围拉取请求”（PR）——即同时修改应用代码和部署基础设施——所带来的因果性集成开销，我们在两个大型数据集（AIDev v5 和 MOSAIC-3M）上评估了26,999个拉取请求，涵盖六种智能体架构以及一个对齐的人类基线。通过确定性的四层文件分类法和精确的4D分层匹配框架，我们在控制应用代码量、保持条件可交换性的前提下，分离出了相关集成指标。
tldr: 该研究通过涵盖26,999个拉取请求的大规模因果分析，首次证明AI智能体同时修改应用代码与部署基础设施的“双范围”拉取请求会引入额外的集成开销，揭示了当前智能体缺乏部署感知能力的关键局限。
